title: Water and fish tanks
subtitle: A face is sealed when all 4 cells are filled
text:
A space with any empty cell can hold water, like a vanilla slab. Placing a piece into water keeps the water, and buckets work as usual.

A face only holds water back when all 4 cells touching it are filled. A bottom slab keeps water above it, and glass vertical slabs make a fish tank wall. A completely filled space holds no water.

steps.text: Water only shows in the empty cells, never through opaque pieces.
Behind glass and other see-through pieces it looks the way it does behind a glass block, whether the glass is in the same space as the water or in the next one.
